**A curated reference database of viral marker-gene sequences for giant viruses, phages and RNA viruses**

VirMarkDB provides protein/nucleotide sequences for ten conserved marker genes across three viral groups: giant viruses (*Nucleocytoviricota*), phages (*Pantevenvirales*) and RNA viruses (*Orthornavirae*), built from ICTV-derived taxonomy.

[Explore the database](database.qmd){.btn-action} [See the workflow](workflow.qmd){.btn-action} [Download](releases.qmd){.btn-action}

:::
